description:
Roman Josi is a James Norris Memorial Trophy winner who now holds the titles of Nashville Predators all-time points leader as well as top goal-scorer among defensemen in franchise history. On this play, Josi exemplifies his distinctive skill set by scoring a goal after receiving the puck while skating backward and maneuvering around the defender towards the net. Deftly deceiving the goalie with a fake pass out front, he opts instead to execute a wraparound goal by bringing the puck behind the net.
